rules.source: Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act, Code of Virginia Title 59.1, Chapter 53 — https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodefull/title59.1/chapter53/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Virginia LIS (search summary): consumers may submit requests to controllers; controllers respond within 45 days with one possible 45-day extension; violations are prohibited practices under §59.1-200; state agencies, GLBA financial institutions and HIPAA covered entities are exempt.
